Job Summary: Lead validation, qualification, and automation of networking and system-level features, involving functional testing, API validation, automation framework development, defect analysis, protocol debugging, traffic validation, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure product quality and release readiness. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, review, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies. Perform functional, regression, interoperability, scale, stress, performance, and negative testing. Validate Layer-2, Layer-3, platform, and management features across virtual and physical test environments. Validate CLI, REST APIs, gNMI, NETCONF, RESTCONF, OpenConfig, YANG models, telemetry, and management interfaces. Develop and maintain Python-based automation frameworks and reusable libraries. Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines. Perform traffic generation, protocol validation, and convergence testing. Analyze packet captures using Wireshark and tcpdump. Perform defect analysis, root cause investigation, and validate fixes. Collaborate with Development, DevOps, Product, and QA teams. Mentor junior engineers and conduct code reviews. Prepare test reports, automation reports, feature qualification reports, and release sign-off documentation.
